_readme.description: Skald Sound Board — master audio manifest v2. Setting + Mood two-step filter system. SFX filtered by section only.

filter_system.music_and_ambient: Two-step: select setting_tag first, then mood_tag. Both fields support multi-value comma-separated tags.
filter_system.sfx: Single filter: section column only (Combat, Magic, Nature, Creature, Object, Stinger, Social)

_readme.supabase_migration: Each entry maps to one row in an audio_files table. mood_tags and setting_tags become array columns or a join table.

music.title: One more round before the trouble
